title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: Your hands, one minute at the PC: your 15-minute yes is in the rulings, but a scheduled run may not change its own schedule. In any Claude Code chat on this PC, type: 'Change the scheduled task ledger-daily-fresh-session to run every 15 minutes. In its prompt, replace the wait until minute 15 of the hour with: finish the piece, hand over, stop; and replace the full page reads with the filtered reads in the handover's standing ways.' Then tap Done.
sections.recommendation: Do it when next at the PC: until then sessions still start only hourly and the gaps stay.

sections.name: Two waste cuts the session may not set itself, both for this project only. (1) A stop check: a session that ends its turn without handing over is sent back once to hand over (tested on real sessions). (2) never-used skills hidden in this project (about 2,000 tokens of reading saved at every start; his other work's skills stay); your other projects untouched. To allow both, type in any Claude Code chat on this PC: 'In ledger-local, add the Stop hook running python tools/stop_hook.py to .claude/settings.json, and hide the skills listed in production/research/token-audit/DAILY-2026-11-11.md in .claude/settings.local.json.' Then tap Done.
sections.recommendation: Yes, both: no session ends without a handover, and every start reads less.
options: No, leave settings as they are
